summary: Correctness release: vector element layout, alias and enum payloads, and reference-passing bugs are fixed, loops no longer exhaust the stack, and the CLI reports program exit codes.

highlights.title: Vector element layout matches the compiled structs
highlights.text: Reading or assigning elements of vectors of structs now uses each struct's padded compiled layout, so a trailing flag or value after a vector-bearing field reads correctly, and assigning optional or result elements keeps the slot's tag and payload readable.

highlights.title: Aliases, enum variants, and determinism
highlights.text: Match payloads behind package type aliases keep their concrete type, bare enum variants resolve to the declaring module instead of the first registered twin, and a hash-order-dependent type lookup that could flip enum field reads between builds is fixed.

highlights.title: References and nested fields write through
highlights.text: Passing a byte vector by reference to string-from-bytes constructors emits valid code again, and calling a mutating method through a nested field updates the original value instead of a discarded copy.

highlights.title: Long loops and tooling
highlights.text: Temporaries created inside loops no longer reserve stack per iteration, builtins on module-level vectors dispatch the real implementations, and the run command exits with the program's exit code.

highlights.title: Iter contracts unblocked
highlights.text: The closure-thunk clause leak is gone on the new pin: Range.count and the retried range set (contains, sum, product, collect, count, max, min, find, all, any, nth, last) carry contracts again, and the iter smoke family passes at high parallelism.

highlights.title: Byte-exact file IO and CRLF-clean line reads
highlights.text: write_file, append_file and write_file_bytes open in binary mode, so newlines are never rewritten when writing on Windows; read_file_lines strips a trailing carriage return so CRLF files parse cleanly. Both carry regression locks.

known_issues: Comparing containers with equality operators is pointer identity: two equal vectors compare unequal, and equal result-of-vector values compare unequal; deep container equality is designed and queued.
A confined allocation followed by a free can spin in the guard heap; keep the exit block as the last statement and avoid manual free until the runtime patch lands.
Hot reload benchmarks that enter confined blocks remain slow while the trampoline cost is worked through.
